findings.problem: The voice states the law and then the result, but never names which two powers are multiplied here, so a student new to the law may not see that 2 × (x − 1) gives 2x − 2.
findings.fix: Change the voice to "The two powers are two and X minus one; two times X minus one is two X minus two, so it is five to the power two X minus two", and keep the result on the same line with no extra line.
